$doc: docs/design-direction.md, sections 1 (motion) and 2 (type). This file is that document in machine-readable form. A value here that disagrees with it is a defect in this file, not a local decision.
$note: Every value matches what the app does today, so introducing the file changes nothing on screen. content/<pack>/style.json is merged OVER this, key by key, and a cue argument still wins over both.

sound.//: How loud this subject's music sits. Metered, not guessed: at bedDb -24 the bed came out 35 dB under the voice, which is inaudible. -8 puts it about 19 dB under while it ducks and 7 dB under between sentences.
